title: Conic Certification of Transformer Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.00585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention is the computational core of large language models, yet the verifiers that bound how far an attention head's output can move under input perturbations give no guarantee on how loose their bounds are. A weak certificate therefore cannot be told apart from a fragile model. We develop a conic programming theory of attention certification that supplies this guarantee. We prove that the difficulty lies not in the softmax but in the bilinear interaction of a varying query with the keys. This interaction makes certification NP-hard over boxes and inapproximable once the attention logits can move by a constant amount. A fixed query or listed token substitutions, by contrast, make the exact worst case efficiently computable. An exponential cone moment relaxation then certifies a head with an error bounded quadratically in the perturbation radius by computable quantities, an order that cannot be improved. translated_title: Transformer注意力机制的锥优化认证
translated_abstract: 注意力机制是大语言模型的计算核心，然而现有的验证器虽能界定注意力头的输出在输入扰动下的偏移范围，却无法保证其界有多紧，因此无法将弱证书与脆弱模型区分开来。我们发展了一套注意力认证的锥规划理论来提供这一保证。我们证明，认证的困难并非来自softmax，而是来自变化的查询与键之间的双线性交互。这种交互使得盒约束下的认证问题成为NP难的，且一旦注意力logits能够移动一个常数幅度，问题便不可近似。相比之下，当查询固定或词元替换可以列举时，精确的最坏情况可以高效计算。随后，基于指数锥的矩松弛方法可以为注意力头提供认证，其误差以可计算的量被扰动半径的二次函数所界定，且这一阶数不可再改进。我们还证明了松弛方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文建立了Transformer注意力认证的锥规划理论，证明认证难点在于查询与键的双线性交互（NP难且不可近似），并提出指数锥矩松弛方法，给出误差按扰动半径二次界定且阶数不可改进的认证保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a conic programming theory of transformer attention certification, proving that hardness stems from the bilinear query-key interaction (NP-hard and inapproximable), and proposes an exponential cone moment relaxation that certifies attention heads with a provably unimprovable error bounded quadratically in the perturbation radius.
